arxiv-2101-10917.title: I Beg to Differ: A study of constructive disagreement in online conversations
arxiv-2101-10917.creator: Christine De Kock & Andreas Vlachos
arxiv-2101-10917.description: Abstract Disagreements are pervasive in human communication. In this paper we investigate what makes disagreement constructive. To this end, we construct WikiDisputes, a corpus of 7 425 Wikipedia Talk page conversations that contain content disputes, and define the task of predicting whether disagreements will be escalated to mediation by a moderator.

arxiv-2106-02328.title: Temporally coherent video anonymization through GAN inpainting
arxiv-2106-02328.creator: Thangapavithraa Balaji, Patrick Blies, Georg Göri, Raphael Mitsch, Marcel Wasserer and Torsten Schön Audi AG, thangapavithraa.balaji@audi.de, Enlite.ai Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt, torsten.schoen@thi.de
arxiv-2106-02328.description: Abstract This work tackles the problem of temporally coherent face anonymization in natural video streams. We propose JaGAN , a two-stage system starting with detecting and masking out faces with black image patches in all individual frames of the video.

arxiv-2307-00365.title: Understanding recent deep-learning techniques for identifying collective variables of molecular dynamics
arxiv-2307-00365.creator: Wei Zhang, Christof Schütte
arxiv-2307-00365.description: Abstract High-dimensional metastable molecular system can often be characterised by a few features of the system, i.e. collective variables (CVs). Thanks to the rapid advance in the area of machine learning and deep learning, various deep learning-based CV identification techniques have been developed in recent years, allowing accurate modelling and efficient simulation of complex molecular systems.

arxiv-2310-08581.title: Universal Visual Decomposer: Long-Horizon Manipulation Made Easy
arxiv-2310-08581.creator: Zichen Zhang, Yunshuang Li, Osbert Bastani, Abhishek Gupta, Dinesh Jayaraman, Yecheng Jason Ma, Luca Weihs, zcczhang.github.io/UVD
arxiv-2310-08581.description: Abstract Real-world robotic tasks stretch over extended horizons and encompass multiple stages. Learning long-horizon manipulation tasks, however, is a long-standing challenge, and demands decomposing the overarching task into several manageable subtasks to facilitate policy learning and generalization to unseen tasks. Prior task decomposition methods require task-specific knowledge, are computationally intensive, and cannot readily be applied to new tasks.

arxiv-2503-20127.title: TURBO: Utility-Aware Bandwidth Allocation for Cloud-Augmented Autonomous Control
arxiv-2503-20127.creator: Peter Schafhalter ∗, Alexander Krentsel ∗, Hongbo Wei, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Sylvia Ratnasamy, Scott Shenker, Ion Stoica
arxiv-2503-20127.description: Abstract Autonomous driving system progress has been driven by improvements in machine learning (ML) models, whose computational demands now exceed what edge devices alone can provide. The cloud offers abundant compute, but the network has long been treated as an unreliable bottleneck rather than a co-equal part of the autonomous vehicle control loop.

arxiv-2504-02762.title: MD-ProjTex: Texturing 3D Shapes with Multi-Diffusion Projection
arxiv-2504-02762.creator: Ahmet Burak Yildirim, Mustafa Utku Aydogdu, Duygu Ceylan, Aysegul Dundar
arxiv-2504-02762.description: Abstract We introduce MD-ProjTex, a method for fast and consistent text-guided texture generation for 3D shapes using pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. At the core of our approach is a multi-view consistency mechanism in UV space, which ensures coherent textures across different viewpoints.

arxiv-2601-11849.title: Local Structure of Epitaxial Single Crystal UO 2+x Thin Films
arxiv-2601-11849.creator: Jarrod C. Lewis, Steven D. Conradson, Jacek Wasik, Lottie M. Harding, Rebecca Nicholls, Jude Laverock, Chris Bell, Ross Springell
arxiv-2601-11849.description: Abstract The influence of oxygen stoichiometry on the uranium local environment is explored in epitaxial single crystal uranium oxide thin films grown by DC magnetron sputtering. Through post-growth annealing, the stoichiometry of as-grown UO 2 films are tuned over an approximate stoichiometry range of 0.07 ≤ x ≤ 0.20 0.07\leq x\leq 0.

pmc-11434396.title: Physical Properties of an Efficient MAPbBr3/GaAs Hybrid Heterostructure for Visible/Near-Infrared Detectors
pmc-11434396.creator: Tarek Hidouri, Maura Pavesi, Marco Vaccari, Antonella Parisini, Nabila Jarmouni, Luigi Cristofolini, Roberto Fornari, Mingjie Li
pmc-11434396.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Semiconductor photodetectors can work only in specific material-dependent light wavelength ranges, connected with the bandgaps and absorption capabilities of the utilized semiconductors. This limitation has driven the development of hybrid devices that exceed the capabilities of individual materials. In this study, for the first time, a hybrid heterojunction photodetector based on methylammonium lead bromide (MAPbBr3) polycrystalline film deposited on gallium arsenide (GaAs) was presented, along with comprehensive morphological, structural, optical, and photoelectrical investigations.

pmc-11579910.title: Convexity dural hemangioma: illustrative case
pmc-11579910.creator: Ellery A. Hayden, Jack A. Leoni, Frank Culicchia
pmc-11579910.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dural hemangiomas are a relatively rare form of intracranial mass, as hemangiomas tend to present in bone or as intraparenchymal lesions and only around 5%–13% have been reported to originate from the dura mater.

pmc-12444518.title: Recent Advances in Electrically Stimulated Insulin Delivery Systems
pmc-12444518.creator: Carlos Alemán, Helena Muñoz-Galán, Maria M. Pérez-Madrigal
pmc-12444518.description: Diabetes mellitus has become one of the greatest medical challenges affecting millions of people globally. Non- and minimally invasive approaches for insulin release are currently being intensively investigated to improve the treatment efficacy and quality of life for diabetic patients.

pmc-12580548.title: The Therapeutic Potential of Cannabidiol in Skin Conditions
pmc-12580548.creator: Maria C Redmond, David P Finn
pmc-12580548.description: BackgroundDermatological disorders can have a negative impact on quality of life. Cannabidiol (CBD) is a phytocannabinoid found in the Cannabis sativa L. plant. It has multiple molecular targets, many of which are expressed in the skin, and may have therapeutic potential in several skin conditions.

pmc-12684574.title: Endothelial Cell‐Related Proteins in Plasma Predict Major Adverse Cardiovascular Events and Worsening Heart Failure in Patients With Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-12684574.creator: Shogo Tamura, Keitaro Akita, Michael A. Fifer, Albree Tower‐Rader, Mathew S. Maurer, Yuichi J. Shimada
pmc-12684574.description: BackgroundHypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) often causes major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and worsening heart failure (HF). Endothelial cell (EC) dysfunction is known to be involved in the pathogenesis of HCM. However, the prognostic value of proteins related to EC function (EC‐related proteins) in HCM is unknown.

pmc-12755878.title: Neisseria gonorrhoeae LIN codes provide a robust, multi-resolution lineage nomenclature
pmc-12755878.creator: Anastasia Unitt, Made A Krisna, Kasia M Parfitt, Keith A Jolley, Martin CJ Maiden, Odile B Harrison, Dominique Soldati-Favre, Anastasia Unitt, Made A Krisna, Kasia M Parfitt, Keith A Jolley, Martin CJ Maiden, Odile B Harrison
pmc-12755878.description: Investigation of the bacterial pathogen Neisseria gonorrhoeae is complicated by extensive horizontal gene transfer: a process which disrupts phylogenetic signals and impedes our understanding of population structure. The ability to consistently identify N. gonorrhoeae lineages is important for surveillance of this increasingly antimicrobial resistant organism, facilitating efficient communication regarding its epidemiology; however, conventional typing systems fail to reflect N.

pmc-12986177.title: Linear Magnetization Curve with Extremely Low Permeability Obtained via Stress Annealing of Fe- and Co-Based Nanocrystalline Alloys
pmc-12986177.creator: Otto K. Temesi, Albert Karacs, Gábor Gulyás, Sándor Komáromi, Lajos K. Varga
pmc-12986177.description: First, the properties of the linear magnetizing curve and low static permeability are summarized. Second, a design for technical implementation of mechanical stress-induced anisotropy in metal-amorphous nanocomposites (MANCs) is presented. Stress annealing, which creates the conditions for a linear magnetizing curve, is an order of magnitude more effective with Co-based MANCs than with Fe-based ones.

pmc-13376223.title: No Simple Fluke: Schistosomiasis as an Emerging Regulator of Haematopoiesis
pmc-13376223.creator: Shinjini Chakraborty
pmc-13376223.description: Schistosomiasis, or bilharzia, is a highly prevalent water‐borne helminth infection that accounts for an estimated 1.5–1.7 billion disability‐adjusted life years lost annually. Pathology driven by adult worms and eggs is accompanied by robust immunomodulation in the human host. Protective responses may promote worm elimination, limit bystander tissue injury caused by parasite migration and contain eggs within granulomatous lesions.

pmc-13418543.title: Shared striatal neurons exhibit context-specific dynamics for internally and externally driven actions
pmc-13418543.creator: Jan L. Klee, Sulekh Fernando-Peiris, Sahil Suresh, Ines Rodrigues-Vaz, Darcy S. Peterka, Rui M. Costa, Vivek R. Athalye, Tanya Sippy

pmc-13472680.title: Behavior change techniques in a care partner–assisted oral health intervention for people with mild dementia: a secondary mixed-methods analysis
pmc-13472680.creator: Jing Wang, Courtney Caiola, Chiao-Hsin Teng, Youngmin Cho, Zhijing Xu, Jackie Finik, Shahrzad Siamdoust, Ya-Ning Chan, Eunjung Ko, Justine Seidenfeld, Ayomide Okanlawon Bankole, Donald E Bailey, Cappye Mott, Bei Wu, Brenda L Plassman, Ruth A Anderson
pmc-13472680.description: Background and ObjectivesOral hygiene declines early in mild dementia (MD), yet few interventions specify which behavior change techniques (BCTs) drive improvement. We examined the use of BCTs in relation to oral health outcomes in a care-partner–assisted intervention for persons living with MD.Research Design and MethodsUsing a secondary convergent mixed-methods design, we analyzed the coaching arm of a three-arm randomized trial.

pmc-13659249.title: Role of Fetoscopic Airway Evaluation Immediately Preceding EXIT Procedure in Fetuses With Suspected Airway Obstruction
pmc-13659249.creator: Daniel Sanin‐Ramirez, Joan Sabria, Josep M. Martinez, Mar Bennasar, Montserrat Izquierdo, Elisenda Eixarch, Eduard Gratacos
pmc-13659249.description: ObjectiveThis study describes the role of pre‐EXIT (Ex Utero Intrapartum Treatment) fetoscopic airway evaluation in fetuses with suspected airway obstruction.MethodsSingle center, retrospective, observational study including fetuses with suspected airway obstruction undergoing fetoscopic airway evaluation prior to EXIT between 2013 and 2025.

pmc-13722262.title: Knowledge, attitude, practice, and perceived barriers of colorectal cancer screening among family physicians in Riyadh second health cluster
pmc-13722262.creator: Abdulrahman Abdulaziz Alkthiry, Hassan Saleh Almohammadi, Khalid Saad Alhamlan, Abdulmalik Khaled Albadi, Abdalah Emad Almhmd
pmc-13722262.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:One of the main causes of cancer-related death globally, colorectal cancer (CRC), is becoming more common in emerging nations. CRC morbidity and death are considerably decreased by effective screening. Family doctors are essential to the implementation of CRC screening.Aim:To assess the knowledge, attitudes, practices (KAP), and perceived barriers related to CRC screening among family physicians working in the Riyadh second health cluster.Methods:In 2025, board-certified family doctors in Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh second health cluster participated in a cross-sectional questionnaire-based survey.
